descriptionHtml:
Bug B18 · P1 · known

Many dates and times follow the device clock instead of server time (UAT 3.8): 'NEW TODAY', admit date, vitals date, task done time, transcript date; with a phone two days slow a held drug is stamped two days back and the next cleanup deletes it

Tickets: TFA-92584 ready for qa (UAT 3.8); TFA-92597 ready for qa (R6); TFA-92579 AC 3/4 ready for qa (NEW TODAY); TFA-94745 ready for qa (draft restore) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Root cause known (Daniela asked for server time on 10-03); the deleted drug, missing badge and wrong draft restore are new symptoms. TC-16/S18 (UAT 3.8, one device set to the wrong date): a phone a day ahead files its bedside line in a row dated tomorrow on the shared record, and the next write from a correctly clocked device lists the lines before it twice (the transcript archive trusts the device date). Which calendar day a correct device should use when its local day and the server's UTC day differ is the open question Q9 (D10); TC-16/S25 passed otherwise. Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92579/92584): a browser whose day is ahead writes the badge roll back to the server, and every device shows Follow-up, with the matching template and billing family (TC-01/S08, TC-20/S20a; TFA-92584 AC 8). The failing cell of TC-25/S24a is the card's NEW TODAY, which compares addedAt with the device's date (PatientCard.tsx:154-156). EFS/S28 (a)(b) restore drafts by the device date (TFA-94745); (c), an old draft put in today's box, is B13's. Review 2026-10-15 (TFA-94514): the analytics day is the device date too (pilotUsageEvents / pilotDailyRounding use localDay()): a phone 3 days ahead files its rows under its own day, and an encounter across the phone midnight is split over two days and never timed (OAT-06/S10). Re-test 2026-10-16 (TC-21/S26, 25acd727): a browser two days ahead writes the badge roll with its own future day (encTypeDay 2026-10-19) to the shared record, so the correct-clock browser shows Follow-up too.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S08, TC-10/S22, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S18, TC-06/S19, OAT-06/S10, TC-06/S23, TC-25/S24b, TC-19/S23, TC-21/S26

Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S22 iOS simulator build on the local stack, and a real phone with a wrong clock

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 No Clinic anywhere: absent from the context switcher and from the template picker (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 4; TFA-92599 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1e Quick Dictation is available in Hospital and absent in Nursing Home (UAT TC-21 step 1; UAT TC-04) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • G3.8 Every time-based rule uses the server clock: retention, carry-forward, the day roll to Follow-up, 'today' on the timeline and the hospital day / visit number. … (UAT 3.8; TFA-92584 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given iOS: a local simulator build bundled for the local stack. Wrong clock: a real Android phone on the local stack through adb reverse, date set 2 days ahead and time zone Pacific/Kiritimati. A desktop browser on the same account for comparison.

When Switch contexts, background and reopen the app; compare the hospital day / visit number, the badge and its pre-selected template, and the timeline's 'today' with the desktop

Then The context is remembered after reopen; the template lists match the web (S04); no Clinic; the same day/visit, badge, pre-selected template and 'today' as the desktop (3.8)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): S04's checkpoints and S26's equality rule, judged by a person. Device clock: known TFA-92584 AC 8.

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-21/S22

iOS simulator build on the local stack, and a real phone with a wrong clock

Tickets: TFA-92584 Admission Status Toggle (ready for qa); TFA-92599 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Android half, phone 2 days ahead in Pacific/Kiritimati (the app asked for a new sign-in after the clock change and got in through its form) vs the desktop on the real clock. Judged (TFA-92584): 2/5 - badge differs in both contexts (phone Follow-up vs desktop New Admission / Consult) and the Hospital pre-selected template differs (SOAP progress vs H&P); the Nursing Home template matches (SNF follow-up on both). Known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8. Worse than a display difference: the phone's day rule wrote the rows back with its own future day (stored encType follow-up, encTypeDay 2026-10-17 for the patient and the resident; the resident's visit date 'Sat Oct 17 2026', U20 gated TFA-94699), so every device now shows Follow-up. The timeline line the phone wrote is dated with the real day ('Visit 1 – Oct 15: Pre-rounded.', TFA-92589) on both. Todo (TFA-92599 in progress, recorded): the context chosen last (Nursing Home) comes back after 8 s in the background and after closing and reopening; template lists match the web; no Clinic anywhere. Hospital day / visit number not shown on main (B23). iOS half not run: the simulator cannot be tapped here without a permission prompt (no idb / Maestro / WebDriverAgent installed; the simulator-control and computer-use tools ask first), and the only booted simulator runs someone else's dev-pointed build (b8fb762), which was left alone. A separate prompt-free smoke on a new simulator (dvc-tc24-s24-ios-*) showed the iOS build on the local stack opening and listing patients.

Product issue: A phone whose clock is two days ahead shows Follow-up for a patient set to New Admission today (and pre-selects the follow-up template), and by opening the chart it rewrites the stored status to Follow-up dated two days ahead, so every device loses the New Admission (known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8).

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 9 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android (Quinn 2026-10-14) — An iOS simulator build and a real Android phone with a wrong clock; iOS and Android are set aside for the dev run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
